description: Elections Commission - Declare that W. L. Ranjith as a member of the Embilipitiya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Embilipitiya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes including the declaration of a newly elected member to fill a vacancy caused by death, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) as it deals with electoral matters and candidate declarations for local government positions.
